name: date-calendar

native.scope: Native declaration and calendar browser lifecycle are not yet verified. Selection is browser draft state; application validation remains authoritative.

ports.name: calendar-selection
ports.purpose: A bubbling cui:date-calendar-changed event exposes a bounded single/range browser draft. The app owns validation and any subsequent workflow.

summary: Deterministic Gregorian month grid with explicit localized labels and optional bounded keyboard interaction.

agent.useWhen: A page needs a visible single-date or date-range calendar with deterministic explicit month/today and localized labels.
agent.avoidWhen: Do not treat this library contract as host admission or use it where no-JS selection is required; unavailable dates require app/server validation.

invariants: Gregorian dates are strict ISO dates in years 0001..9999; month is explicit and first-of-month and today is explicit.
The caller supplies all 12 month labels and seven short and full weekday labels; Native has no CultureInfo or implicit locale fallback.
Renders exactly six weeks and 42 cells with explicit outside-month, today, selection, range, and unavailable states.
Selection mode is single or range; range dates are ordered and may have an open end.
Readonly calendars are useful without JavaScript; interactive dates and month navigation require the admitted interaction module.
Calendar selection is presentation only; host admission and app/server validation remain authoritative.
